Metadata.title: Soft Boring Weekly
Metadata.description: A quiet weekly review. Six small questions, once a week.

Home.title: A quiet review for a quieter week.
Home.lead: Soft Boring Weekly is a once-a-week check-in. Six small questions. No dashboards, no streaks, no noise.
Home.ideaBody: Once a week, sit down for a few minutes. Notice what gave you energy, what took it, and what you want next week to hold. Save it. Come back later if you want to remember.
Home.pricingFree: Free for your first four weeks of reviews.
Home.pricingPaid: A small paid plan later unlocks history and trends.
Home.pricingNote: Payments are not connected yet. This is a teaser for what is coming.
